app.tagline: Early warning for operators and community leaders
app.disclaimer: A support tool to detect, decide and warn. It does not replace the official warning systems (INDECI, regional COERs, SISMATE).

failedPage.title: Failed readings
failedPage.forbidden: Your role cannot see failed readings: operators and administrators can.
failedPage.explanation: The evaluator could not process these readings after 5 attempts. Each one may be an alert that did not go out: check the error, fix the cause and reprocess them.
failedPage.empty: No failed readings: every one was evaluated.
failedPage.error: The failed readings could not be loaded.
failedPage.caption: Readings the evaluator could not process
failedPage.confirm_one: Reprocess the selected reading? It goes back to the queue and the evaluator takes it within seconds. If the cause was not fixed, it will fail again after 5 attempts.
failedPage.confirm_other: Reprocess the {{count}} selected readings? They go back to the queue and the evaluator takes them within seconds. If the cause was not fixed, they will fail again after 5 attempts.
failedPage.reprocessFailed: They could not be reprocessed. Try again.
